request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set a fixed cap of 500,000,000 ada on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during the period from Epoch 613 through Epoch 713.
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period.
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit.
Record DRep agreement if Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake.
request.what: Info action to record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only lovelace removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer states that an existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 has served as a useful fiscal guardrail but is becoming constrained.
The proposer states that the new limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed guardrail.
The proposer states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake is the TREASURY-01a threshold for agreeing a Net Change Limit.
The proposer states the action is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references an IPFS copy of that constitution.
The proposer states that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action establishing a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, defining how withdrawals count, excluding inflows, counting prior period withdrawals, and asserting constitutional consistency without authorizing any withdrawal itself.
